definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.comparatorRegret
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (prediction t)) - ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t u
definitions.header: noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegret
definitions.header: def NoRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X) : Prop

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.LimitNoRegret
definitions.exact_source_block:
def LimitNoRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ V, ∃ a : ℝ, a ≤ 0 ∧
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)
definitions.header: def LimitNoRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X) : Prop

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.empiricalMean
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def empiricalMean (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, y t) / n
definitions.header: noncomputable def empiricalMean (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def meanPredict (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 1/2 else empiricalMean y t
definitions.header: noncomputable def meanPredict (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlPredict
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def ftlPredict (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then initial else empiricalMean y t
definitions.header: noncomputable def ftlPredict (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlMeanStep
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def ftlMeanStep (state : ℕ × ℝ) (target : ℝ) : ℕ × ℝ :=
  (state.1 + 1, state.2 + (target - state.2) / ((state.1 : ℝ) + 1))
definitions.header: noncomputable def ftlMeanStep (state : ℕ × ℝ) (target : ℝ) : ℕ × ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ftlState
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def ftlState (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ × ℝ
  | 0 => (0, initial)
  | t + 1 => ftlMeanStep (ftlState initial y t) (y t)
definitions.header: noncomputable def ftlState (initial : ℝ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ × ℝ | 0 => (0, initial) | t + 1 => ftlMeanStep (ftlState initial y t) (y t) theorem ftlPredict_prefix (initial : ℝ) (y z : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (h : ∀ i < t, y i = z i) : ftlPredict initial y t = ftlPredict initial z t

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.squaredBestRegret
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t - y t)^2) -
    sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - y t)^2) ''
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
definitions.header: noncomputable def squaredBestRegret (y prediction : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.expectedFixedMinimum
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def expectedFixedMinimum {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  sInf ((fun u : ℝ => ∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) ''
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
definitions.header: noncomputable def expectedFixedMinimum {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.expectedFixedRegret
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def expectedFixedRegret {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (Y prediction : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t ω - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) -
    expectedFixedMinimum μ Y T
definitions.header: noncomputable def expectedFixedRegret {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) (Y prediction : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.privateSeedPastInformation
definitions.exact_source_block:
def privateSeedPastInformation {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Seed]
    (S : Ω → Seed) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace Ω :=
  MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => (S ω, fun i : (↑(Finset.range t) : Type) => Y i ω))
    inferInstance
definitions.header: def privateSeedPastInformation {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Seed] (S : Ω → Seed) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace Ω

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.dyadicObservation
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def dyadicObservation : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => 1 - dyadicObservation (n / 2)
termination_by n => n
decreasing_by omega
definitions.header: noncomputable def dyadicObservation : ℕ → ℝ | 0 => 0 | n + 1 => 1 - dyadicObservation (n / 2) termination_by n => n decreasing_by omega theorem meanPredict_limitNoRegret_iff_mean_converges (y : ℕ → ℝ) (hy : ∀ t, y t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y) ↔ ∃ m ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Tendsto (empiricalMean y) atTop (nhds m)

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.GuessingLower.binaryStream
definitions.exact_source_block:
def binaryStream (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : Bool :=
  (h.reverse[t]?).getD false
definitions.header: def binaryStream (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : Bool

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.GuessingLower.binaryValues
definitions.exact_source_block:
def binaryValues (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if binaryStream h t then 1 else 0
definitions.header: def binaryValues (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.GuessingLower.causalPredict
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def causalPredict (A : List Bool → ℝ) (y : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  A (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin t => y i)).reverse
definitions.header: noncomputable def causalPredict (A : List Bool → ℝ) (y : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ

definitions.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.GuessingLower.pathRegret
definitions.exact_source_block:
noncomputable def pathRegret (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - binaryValues h t)^2)
    (causalPredict A (binaryStream h)) (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length) h.length
definitions.header: noncomputable def pathRegret (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) : ℝ
